description: This file defines classes and methods for controlling and managing a virtual platform (FVP) in a testing environment, including state transitions, console setup, and command execution.

classes.name: OEFVPTargetState
classes.description: An enumeration representing the possible states of the FVP target: OFF, ON, and LINUX.

classes.name: OEFVPTarget
classes.description: A class for managing the lifecycle and interaction with a virtual platform (FVP), including starting, stopping, transitioning states, and setting up consoles.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FVP target with configuration parameters and setting up initial state.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles transitioning the FVP to a specified state (OFF, ON, LINUX) with appropriate actions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Placeholder method for starting the FVP lazily.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions the FVP to the OFF state.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command on the FVP, ensuring it is in the LINUX state.

methods.name: _setup_consoles
methods.description: Sets up console terminals based on the FVP configuration.

methods.name: _create_logfile
methods.description: Creates and manages log files for console output.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Dynamically exposes methods of the pexpect API on the target, allowing calls to be forwarded to specific terminals.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Property that retrieves the current FVP configuration.
